program.name: NC0_k-Avoid Laboratory
program.positioning: Structural and algorithmic study of range avoidance and circuit lower-bound interfaces

current_decision.primary_goal: Develop constructible gate orders and parameterized projected-DAG upper bounds

stable_results.claim: Positive-stretch pure AND_k circuits admit an explicit separator of degree at most k+1.
Efficiently represented affine output-fiber mixtures are deterministically avoidable in polynomial time for m>n.
A five-block orbit-0x07 instance and an infinite direct-sum family refute the direct affine-style block-redundancy analogy.
Bijunctive orientation depth d gives an m^{O(d)} poly(n+m) deterministic avoidance algorithm.
For nonempty S contained in at most half the m-cube, the internal-boundary fraction is at least binom(m,floor(m/2))/2^(m-1).
The V57 direct-sum family is flat across several first-step potentials.
If image membership is polynomial-time and m>n, uniform output sampling is Las Vegas with expected trials at most two.
The V57 collapsed conjunction is clause-irredundant 2-CNF while the circuit statement is complete irredundancy of five orbit-constrained gate blocks.
Quick and full cumulative verification pass in a clean GitHub Actions checkout with only justified skips.
The V57 five-block gadget has a normative specification and independently verified theorem/proof module.
The V56 affine dichotomy has a standalone proof module and exhaustive finite set-theoretic validation through dimension three.
Exact n=3 affine-cell branching censuses and a deterministic n=4 stress sample quantify pruning without asserting an asymptotic bound.
Direct sums of c=1 V57 components cannot amplify consistent branches, while a seeded overlapping-support probe preserves c=16 at n=10 and finds c=36 at n=11.
An explicit stretch-one orbit-0x07 spine family has c=2^(k-1), forcing exponentially many complete tree leaves, while a projected residual DAG has 3k+4 nonterminal states.

Projected residual layers depend only on the processed gate set, so the minimum over gate orders is an exact shortest path in the subset lattice; preserved fixed-order records collapse strongly under exact reordering.

Projected affine residual layer width is bounded by the number of affine subspaces on the support frontier, with exact factorisation over processed incidence components and deterministic support-order benchmarks.

retractions.claim: Incidence girth greater than 4t implies t-union-freeness.
retractions.reason: Nested equal-union collisions need not create incidence cycles.

retractions.claim: A stretch-one AND3 family has syndrome degree Omega(log n) by the retracted girth implication.
